text: Client files are full of private data. Sending them to a cloud tool to clean them defeats the point.
Drop photos, PDFs and screen recordings. Several at once.
Tick what to hide: names, faces, emails, addresses, IDs, cards, licence plates...
Add things only you know about, like your car's plate.
And keep your own details visible.
Three open models read every line on this laptop: fixed patterns, GLiNER2-PII and Gemma 4.
Everything found gets a solid black box. Not blur: blur can be undone.
Review the list. Untick anything that should stay visible.
Missed something? Draw a box by hand.
In screen recordings the boxes follow the text while it scrolls.
Export clean copies. Your originals are never touched.
PDFs are redacted for real: the hidden text is deleted from the file, not covered.
The exported screen recording, ready to share.
